decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated several Bluetooth speakers across various price points, excluding the many accessories like cases and cables that dominated the feed. My consideration set included high-value budget options like the EDUPLINK and Raymate, which offered 20W-30W sound for under $40, as well as the DOSS SoundBox Pro+. Ultimately, I chose the Harman Kardon Onyx Studio 6. It is designated as the 'Overall Pick' and holds the highest rating (4.7) among the serious audio equipment. Reviews consistently praise its sound quality and bass performance, making it the most reliable choice for a quality speaker despite the higher cost.
